about:
O'Callaghan Cable Services, Inc. operates from Summerville, South Carolina, where it has provided telecommunication and cable construction services for more than three decades. The company began in South Carolina and has since expanded to execute projects nationwide, though no specific founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in communication infrastructure construction, offering make-ready surveys, aerial and underground cable placement, fiber optic and coaxial splicing, fusion splicing and testing, fiber blowing, microduct installation, and electronics installation. It also provides project management, system sweep and certification, system hardening for VoIP and new technologies, inventory management, and full or partial turnkey delivery. Emergency restoration services are available 24/7 for natural disasters and other service interruptions.

Its customers include telecommunications carriers, cable system operators, broadband providers, and wireless infrastructure firms. The company has performed cell tower backhaul construction, FTTx builds, coaxial system upgrades, and emergency response for hurricane, tornado, flood, and ice events across the country.

O'Callaghan Cable Services emphasizes a highly trained workforce, consistent and trustworthy service, and clear communication with clients as its distinguishing factors. The company states that its crews focus on efficient, expedient work while maintaining concise client communication throughout each project.
